config.label: A workspace-scoped API key, created in Laver under Admin → API keys
config.description: A workspace-scoped API key, created in Laver under Admin → API keys. It acts as the person who created it, so it holds exactly their access and can be revoked without touching their account. Supply this or LAVER_API_KEY_FILE.

config.label: Alternative to LAVER_API_KEY: a path to a file holding nothing but the key, or a
config.description: Alternative to LAVER_API_KEY: a path to a file holding nothing but the key, or a .env-style file carrying a LAVER_API_KEY= line. Use this to keep the key out of your client's config file.

config.label: Overrides the API host
config.description: Overrides the API host. Defaults to https://api.laver.app, and must be https except for localhost.
